_doc: How zsdlc-import-factory sorts the incubator's .github/factory/ (CD, 2026-10-12: a private project of the organization's, the incubator, incubates the factory and z-sdlc imports it). Every file there is bundle code (copied into bundles/factory/tree/) unless it is a seed (the bundle keeps its own generic version in bundles/factory/seed/) or excluded (the project's own, never imported). free_settings: JSON seed settings whose keys are the project's own data, not compared. optional_settings: JSON seed settings the bundle's code reads only when they're there, which the incubator may leave out (it doesn't use them). specific: patterns that mark incubator-specific text (its name, private and VPN address ranges, home directories), flagged when an import adds them. last_import: the incubator commit the bundle code was last imported from; the tool updates it.
